headline: Norse Atlantic Airways Faces Financial Crisis as Shares Plunge 70%
summary: Norwegian carrier Norse Atlantic Airways warned of a severe internal financial crisis, prompting the aviation authority to issue a coercive fine over unpaid passenger compensation claims, while its shares crashed roughly 70 percent on the Oslo Stock Exchange.
why: Airline liquidity strains and regulatory enforcement actions pose severe insolvency risks for low-cost long-haul carriers.

impacts.name: Norse Atlantic ASA
impacts.why: Acute liquidity shortages and regulatory penalties trigger massive equity sell-offs.
